# Stripe Wipe

**Wipe › Pattern** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (12–60)

Diagonal stripes of the new scene open one after another and widen until they join.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/stripe-wipe@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Sports and broadcast graphics
- Energetic topic changes
- Lower-thirds into full screen

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import stripeWipe from './transitions/03-wipe/pattern/stripe-wipe';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(stripeWipe, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer | `7` | 2–24 | Number of stripes. |
| `angle` | number | `60` | 0–180 | Stripe angle in degrees. |
| `stagger` | number | `0.5` | 0–0.9 | How much the stripes open one after another. |
